changed_from: {who} changed the permission mode from “{from}” to “{to}”
restart_queued: {who} picked “{to}”: the session restarts in it once this turn ends
why_process_exited: the process it was picked for has exited
why_process_replaced: the session runs in another process now
why_process_unknown: it couldn't tell which process to restart
why_start_failed: the new process didn't start, so the session carries on as before
why_stopped: the new process didn't start, and the session has stopped
